meta.title: Improve string/comment parsing performance
meta.body_summary: Refactor string and comment parsing in json_parser.py to accumulate characters in lists instead of repeated concatenation, claiming performance improvement.

perf_labels.notes: Author self-closed quickly after noting test command failure (no pytest module); no review or benchmark, inferring lack of verification led to abandonment.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 63 changed lines in a single file, this is a minimal edit by absolute volume. As a tiny self-contained string-building perf fix, it was closed—not merged—by the author presumably due to inability to test the performance claim.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or human comment text; author closed PR shortly after creation.
review_details.performance_claim: Avoid repeated string concatenations during parsing by accumulating characters in lists and joining at the end.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author self-closed without verification; body notes 'python3 -m pytest -q' fails with 'No module named pytest', suggesting inability to test.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent produced a low-level string concatenation refactor; author lacked a runnable test suite to validate the perf claim and closed the PR within minutes.

detection_detail.code_reading: No reviewer involvement; author self-closed without external detection.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or timing data; only a narrative claim and a non-functional pytest command.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge, no further iteration.

core_change_summary.description: In src/json_repair/json_parser.py, replaced repeated string concatenation inside parsing loops with list accumulation and final join, affecting string and comment construction.
change_trajectory: Single commit refactoring string and comment parsing to use list accumulation.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with one commit, no reviews, and self-closed ~11 minutes later.
